## How I work

- Outbound: personalization is the whole message, not the first line. Each message is built on one problem spotted on the prospect's website or socials, the pain it causes, and one small ask.
- Inbound: not posting and waiting. Source the ideal customers, engage with their content naturally so they see the expertise, and let them reach out first.
- Meta ads: AI generates variants for each angle (benefit, purpose, pain) across each audience; performance decides where budget goes.
- Lead scoring: score visible pain (hiring, posts, website, workflows), not just industry, size and title.
